UltraVisual.name: Ultra Visual
UltraVisual.description: Every effect: strong glass and glow, animated background, 3D robots at 60 fps.

Balanced.name: Balanced
Balanced.description: Glass, glow and smooth motion; 2D robots at 30 fps. The default.

Performance.name: Performance
Performance.description: No blur or glow, shorter motion, static background. More resources for agents.

BatterySaver.name: Battery Saver
BatterySaver.description: Lowest power: no effects, no motion, slow chart refresh.

autoDegradeDesc: If frames keep missing their budget, step down one mode (never below Performance).

degraded.title: Visual effects lowered
degraded.body: The interface was stuttering, so Orkestr switched to “{{mode}}” to keep agents fast. Change it in Settings → Interface.
